prompt:
For a plain-text report generator, we need a proper full-justify (not just word-wrap): every line stretched to fill the exact column width, the way an old word processor's "justify" button works, not a ragged-right wrap. Please add a new `justify.py` module at the project root with `justify_paragraph(text, width)`, `justify_text(text, width)`, and a `JustifyError` exception, exactly as specified in `README.md`.

The README spells out exactly how the greedy line-filling, the space distribution, and -- importantly -- the last line of a paragraph are each supposed to behave; a couple of these are easy to get wrong by analogy with simpler wrapping code, so please follow it precisely rather than reusing a half-remembered word-wrap routine. A couple of basic checks are sketched in `tests/test_justify.py`.
